experiment: Voxel session G (combined paper W1): complete SIMP optimizations inside Yang et al.'s Galerkin GMG with three FP64-operator arms, RTX 4090, two hosts
status_at_declaration: Declared before any session G rental. One byte-identical package per host; host 2 must be a different provider machine.
questions: H11: in the all-FP64 schedule, does modal8_muladd shorten complete SIMP runs by >= 1.10x against fused_ai_fp64 (the strongest published FP64 kernel)?
H12: in their default mixed schedule (FP32 fused fine smoother), is the effect < 1.10x, because only outer FP64 products change?
Equivalence: do the arms reach the same designs and compliances?
schedule_note: mixed = their E3 SolverV4 configuration exactly; fp64 = the same with gmg_fine_smoother='fp64' and no fused FP32 kernel. Solver tolerances are their defaults (cg_tol 1e-5, cg_maxiter 1000); outer solver 'auto' (PCG).

simp.oc: top88 (Andreassen et al. 2011): bisection l1=0, l2=1e9 until (l2-l1)/(l1+l2) <= 1e-3, on filtered sensitivities
simp.deviation_from_their_e3: their E3 has no filter and an OC whose multiplier bisection cannot go below ~8e9, which collapses the design to the lower bound (verified on a CPU replica before declaration, report section 22). W1 therefore uses the standard top88 update; their loop is run once as a diagnostic.

decision.equivalence: per host, case and schedule, repetition 1: each non-stock arm's final compliance within 1e-3 (relative) of the stock arm's, and no non-converged solve (outer iterations reaching cg_maxiter) in any run. Maximum per-step compliance difference and design relative L2 are reported. Volume of the final physical design must be within 1e-3 of volfrac in every run (OC check).
decision.work_match: for an H11/H12 comparison of arms X and Y in a repetition, total outer iterations must agree within 3 %; a case where any repetition fails this is 'unqualified' for timing and reported as such
decision.ratio: r = wall(fused_ai_fp64) / wall(modal8_muladd) for the same repetition, case and schedule (paired within a repetition)
decision.H11: on a host, passes if, for every primary case in the fp64 schedule, the median r over completed repetitions is >= 1.10, at least 2 repetitions completed, the case is work-matched and equivalence holds. Replicated if it passes on both hosts.
decision.H12: reported as the median r per case in the mixed schedule; the declared expectation is r < 1.10
decision.reproduction: wall(stock)/wall(modal8_muladd) and wall(stock)/wall(fused_ai_fp64) are reported but are not speedup claims (stock is their CuPy gather+DGEMM+bincount path)
decision.breakdown: per-step gmg_setup_ms, cg_ms and sensitivity_ms (their profiling timers) are reported to explain end-to-end dilution

not_claimed: Speedups are for 30-step density-filtered SIMP runs (their E3 settings with the top88 OC) on RTX 4090s; the complete-optimization runs are single and descriptive.
A speedup is not novelty; the basis and butterfly are classical/borrowed (report sections 14-18).

their_e3_diagnostic.purpose: record volume and compliance trajectories of their verbatim E3 loop at their size; descriptive
